text:
alex: Heads up - nightly SAST+DAST pipeline failed, scanner couldn't download build artifacts (HTTP 403).

maria: any immediate errors in the scanner logs?

devops-bot: [artifact-store] GET /artifacts/build-2024-08-02.tar.gz -> 403 Forbidden (Auth: role=scanner-runner-prod)

ryan: looks like KMS decrypt is failing for the scanner principal earlier. saw CloudTrail entries around 2024-07-31T18:23Z.

maria: can you paste the KMS failure?

ryan: ```
Error: AccessDeniedException
Message: user arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/scanner-runner-prod/session does not have kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-efgh
RequestId: abc123
```

alex: iirc infra rolled a policy-consolidation last week (PR #4291). could be the culprit.

maria: immediate mitigation: grant a scoped kms:Decrypt to scanner-runner-prod for that key for 30 minutes. ops/oncall please apply and monitor.

oncall-ops: applying temp inline policy now with a 30m TTL. policy snippet: 
```
Effect: Allow
Action: ["kms:Decrypt"]
Resource: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-efgh"
Condition: StringEquals { aws:RequestedRegion: "us-west-2" }
```

alex: thanks. after that, re-run the nightly job. also capture artifact-store access logs to ensure no other principals lost access.

sec-bot: [scan-runner] nightly job restarted 2024-08-02T01:02Z -> failed previously, re-run in progress.

ryan: investigating CloudTrail: infra-bot performed DetachRolePolicy and removed an attached policy that previously granted kms:Decrypt to scanner-runner-prod while doing S3-perm tightening. seems like policy consolidation removed cross-attached perms.

maria: root cause hypothesis: separate permissions for S3 and KMS lived in different artifacts; consolidation removed the KMS one. pre-merge checks didn't simulate downstream calls to KMS.

alex: action items: (1) ops applied temporary fix (2) add a pre-merge simulated-access test that runs a dry-run of artifact fetches using affected roles (3) add an audit alert triggered when kms:Decrypt is removed from roles matching artifact consumers.

oncall-ops: re-run finished 6765460072 - result: success :white_check_mark:. logs show artifact fetch completed after policy applied.

maria: i'll file an RCA doc and include CloudTrail snippets + PR refs. will also open infra ticket to add the simulated-access job and require sec-oncall approval on policy-consolidation PRs that affect artifact roles.

ryan: also propose we add a nightly 'permission smoke test' that picks a few critical roles and performs test decrypt/prefetch to catch regressions during deployments.

alex: agree. i'll loop in infra leads and schedule a 20-min sync. closing thread after RCA is published. :thumbsup:
